name: mehrwearing-shopping
description: MehrWearingShopping — men's fashion e-commerce platform (Persian/English, RTL-first) with an API-first architecture for web, mobile and desktop clients.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:api && bun run build:web
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:client && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/mobile typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/api-client test && bun run --cwd apps/api test && bun run --cwd apps/web test
scripts.openapi:client: bun run openapi && bun run --cwd packages/api-client generate
